name: CD45
evidence: the large ectodomains of CD45 and CD148 enable their passive, size-based segregation from ligated T-cell receptor; the extracellular region of CD45 is rigid and extends beyond the distance spanned by receptor-ligand complexes, so sites of engagement sterically exclude it; the kinetic-segregation model (review)

name: CD45RO
evidence: the smallest isoform, without residues 34-194 of the canonical sequence (UniProt P08575-4): 38 disordered residues with 4 predicted glycosites stand on the same folded region; its ectodomain is about 21.6 nm from end to end

name: CD148
evidence: the large ectodomains of CD45 and CD148 enable their passive, size-based segregation from ligated T-cell receptor
